description: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 is currently live in India, bringing aggressive festive price cuts across a massive lineup of electronics, smartphones, and tablets. Whether you need a portable productivity machine for work, a creative canvas for sketching, or an entertainment powerhouse for streaming movies, major brands like Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, and Lenovo are offering substantial discounts on their tablet offerings. We have rounded up the best tablet deals that you can grab right now.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Tablet Deals

description: With the winter season approaching, the off-season is one of the best times to invest in a new AC. Brands such as Hitachi, Panasonic, Carrier, Daikin, Voltas, and Midea have rolled out steep discounts of up to 65 percent on their respective cooling solutions during the Amazon Great Indian Festival. Shoppers looking to upgrade their home cooling systems can maximise their savings through other sale promotions like bank discounts and EMI benefits, in addition to direct price cuts.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Air Conditioner Deals

description: During the Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 sale, buyers can find discounts on soundbars from brands such as Blaupunkt, Zebronics, boAt, JBL and Sonos. In addition to these price reductions, customers can get an extra discount on select bank cards. Shoppers can also receive cashback using the Amazon Pay ICICI Bank credit card or Amazon Pay Later.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Soundbar Deals With Dolby Atmos

description: Amazon's Great Indian Festival 2026 sale brings five wireless ANC headphones under Rs. 10,000, with discounts of up to 80 percent off their listed MRPs. The deals cover options from Sennheiser, JBL, Sony, Skullcandy and Noise, with prices starting at Rs. 3,499. Buyers can choose between models offering hybrid noise cancellation, multipoint connectivity and quick charging, while the Noise Airwave Max 5 claims up to 80 hours of battery life. Additional bank discounts and cashback are available on select purchases.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best ANC Headphones Under Rs 10,000

description: The Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 sale started last week. The sale brings discounts on a wide range of home appliances, including premium refrigerators from leading brands such as Godrej, Haier, LG and Samsung. Buyers looking to upgrade their kitchens can consider large-capacity refrigerator models at reduced prices during the festive sale. Here we have curated the best deals.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Premium Refrigerator Deals

description: Amazon's Great Indian Festival 2026 sale features discounts on 5-star washing machines from LG, Samsung, Bosch and Haier, with listed prices ranging from Rs. 23,990 to Rs. 62,990. Select Samsung, LG, Bosch, and Haier washing machines also qualify for additional bank discounts during the sale.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best 5-Star Washing Machine Deals

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 has listed various large and small home appliances at discounted prices in India. You can purchase washing machines, refrigerators, kitchen chimneys, and microwave ovens at relatively low prices from reputable brands including Samsung, Haier, LG, Panasonic, Faber, and Inalsa. title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Home Appliance Deals Like Washing Machines, Refrigerators and More

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 has listed new air purifiers from different brands at discounted prices. You can also get an instant discount of 10 percent with an SBI credit or debit card and an SBI credit card EMI transaction. The company is also offering a 5 percent cashback with the Amazon Pay ICICI Bank credit card.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Air Purifier Deals From Mijia by Xiaomi, Philips and More

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 offers discounts on top-loading washing machines from Haier, LG, Bosch and Samsung. title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Top-Loading Washing Machine Deals

description: The Amazon Great Indian Festival sale is now live and we're specifically looking at deals on laptops with at least 16GB of RAM and 512GB of SSD storage. The Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3, on the other hand, comes with an Intel Core i7-13620H processor and is cheaper at Rs. 77,990.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Laptop Deals With 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD
